Configured the requested DNS hierarchy on pc1–pc13, with pc14 as the recursive resolver and pc16–pc20 as clients. DNS configuration files and startup commands were added, and pc1–pc14 now use the `kathara/bind` image.

`www.example.com` remains unset because the lab identifies no web service host. Startup shell syntax passed; BIND validation tools were unavailable, and the lab was not started for dynamic testing.
